title: TicketHub's Tipping Point Architecture Kata
description: TicketHub sells tickets for around 200 independent venues and is about to host its biggest ever on-sale - on an architecture that was never built for it. We'll review the current system, find the bottlenecks, and design how to evolve it from where it is today to where it needs to be.
